niche: SuccessAddictives-style viral knowledge, motivation, business, money, founders, tech, AI, Hollywood, celebrities, influencers, creator economy, sports, strange facts, human-interest, self-development, culture, future trends
audience: Ambitious, curious Instagram users who stop for big names, celebrity/influencer milestones, surprising numbers, founder lessons, money moves, strange facts, emotional human stories, and self-development angles.
tone_rules: Bold, simple, mainstream, and visual-first. Prefer public milestones, career decisions, money/status moves, creator/influencer news, celebrity success stories, strange facts, and emotional human stories. Avoid cheap gossip; make the angle feel like a lesson, surprising fact, or status signal.
headline_style: X just..., X is ending..., X became..., After X years..., The reason X..., This is why..., X is now..., The most...
caption_style: Start with the strongest public fact, add source-led context in plain English, then explain the lesson, status signal, emotional reason, or why people care.
visual_style: Wealth-style black/yellow collage: full-bleed photo, huge condensed yellow headline, circular insets, arrows/circles when useful, tiny source line.

niche: India, economy, geopolitics, infrastructure, culture, tech
audience: Young Indians and global India-watchers who follow economic growth, national progress, geopolitics, infrastructure, and tech.
tone_rules: Bold, informative, slightly dramatic. Be proud and urgent without becoming inflammatory.
headline_style: India just..., The world is noticing..., This could change India's future...
caption_style: Lead with the national relevance, explain why it matters globally, keep the framing factual and energetic.
visual_style: Clean news editorial design with India map or city/infrastructure cues, saffron/green accents used sparingly, clear source line.

niche: women, relationships, lifestyle, psychology, career, beauty trends
audience: Modern women interested in relationships, self-worth, career, beauty, emotional intelligence, and social trends.
tone_rules: Relatable, emotional, modern. Make the angle feel like a sharp observation, not a judgment.
headline_style: Women are realizing..., Most girls secretly..., This habit says a lot...
caption_style: Start with a relatable hook, unpack the social or emotional insight, end with self-worth or reflection.
visual_style: Modern editorial lifestyle design, warm highlights, expressive portrait or beauty/career imagery, clean typography.

niche: CEO, founders, business, leadership, money, productivity, startups, AI, work culture
audience: Ambitious founders, operators, creators, executives, students, and professionals who want to think and move like CEOs.
tone_rules: Executive, sharp, strategic, premium, and direct. Make every angle feel like a business insight a CEO would care about.
headline_style: CEOs are quietly..., This is how leaders think..., The real reason..., Most people miss this..., This CEO move explains...
caption_style: Start with a sharp business hook, explain the strategic lesson, then end with a practical leadership or ambition takeaway.
visual_style: Premium black/yellow business editorial design, boardroom or city skyline cues, bold clean headline, luxury corporate feel, clear source line.
